This role is responsible for coordinating daily testing activities, conducting driver orientations and operational training, managing route assignments, monitoring driving progress, and ensuring that all testing activities are executed according to client requirements and established operational procedures.

This position requires strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and monitoring skills, with the ability to manage multiple Drivers and ensure smooth execution of daily vehicle testing activities.
